items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: We stole Zalipo's music... Zalipo is the nigga comedian. He was good... alright Zalipo, we're gonna play you a piece.

ctx.x: You know, I noticed you mentioned a lot of Germans with Steckler by name that they sound like... It was all Germans.

It was all Germans. Baptiste is the only Frenchman. His name is Jean-Baptiste Steckler. And I used to laugh, my daughter. He was a case. He still is a case. Yeah, I learned down at Holy Cross College. And when I started playing with what we call a GDNC band, that is four pieces or five pieces, they could play and I couldn't because I could read and they could and I couldn't fake. They could fake what I couldn't read. Boy, was a dag-gun this time trying to get next to that, but it didn't take long. It didn't take…
Which was your very first job playing music professionally? Professionally?
